name: Drunk
overview: Scripture warns against the dangers of drunkenness, portraying strong drink as a deceiver that leads to unwise behavior and poverty. The Bible cautions believers to avoid association with those who indulge in excessive drinking and revelry, emphasizing that such actions bring sorrow, contention, and spiritual ruin. Christians are urged to live honorably and soberly, as drunkenness is listed among behaviors that disqualify one from inheriting the kingdom of God.
